facts.fact: The FY2026/27 estimates appropriate P251,000,000 (BWP) for the Information and Communications Technology project (12481) of the Ministry of Communications and Innovation, financed from the domestic development fund; the ministry's Committee of Supply speech itemises it, including P13,000,000 for cyber security.
facts.system: Ministry of Communications and Innovation ICT project 12481, FY2026/27

facts.fact: The ministry's whole development budget for FY2026/27 is P473,200,000, which the document says is down 11.5% on the FY2025/26 revised figure and 44.6% on the FY2025/26 appropriation.
facts.system: Ministry of Communications and Innovation development budget, FY2026/27 vs FY2025/26
